evidence_note: The calculation rules and worked tables are explicit on the inspected technical page, but its authorship, statutory authority and exact astronomical implementation are not established. Rules remain grade D until independently recomputed and checked against Vietnamese almanacs.

conclusion.lunar_month_day_1: the Vietnamese local civil date containing the astronomical New Moon instant

exceptions: The source page does not define the ephemeris, timescale, numerical tolerance or historical civil-time law for all supported years.
This rule cannot be applied proleptically to a historical royal calendar without a regime-specific source.

rules.publication_limit: Always show the calendar profile and civil-time basis. If uncertainty crosses local midnight, return alternate lunar dates instead of choosing one.

conclusion.target_interval: the lunar month containing the winter solstice on the configured Vietnamese local civil-day basis

exceptions: A solstice and New Moon near local midnight can assign a different month-11 interval in Vietnam and China.

conclusion.selected_interval: the first lunar month after the first winter-solstice anchor that contains no principal term
conclusion.numbering: repeat the preceding lunar month number and mark the selected interval intercalary

exceptions: Principal-term containment must use the same local civil-day and boundary convention as month starts.
The exact astronomical longitude and apparent/mean convention for principal terms must be declared.
